title: A guard or check file that a PR changes is judged by main's copy, not the PR's
why: Owner, 19:45 CST Nov 17 (relayed by the consultant): review the Claude Code team blogs https://claude.dev/blog/how-the-claude-code-team-thinks-about-verification/ and https://claude.dev/blog/solving-code-review-at-anthropic/ and land their findings. Triage read both through a page summary, not word for word. Finding: Verification blog: if a change can modify the check that judges it, the check is broken; review rules are read from the base branch.
source: owner words 19:45 CST Nov 17 via the consultant; blogs read through a page summary
note: Red case: test-author (haiku) 7b2d62ce30 on lane/check-judged-by-main-copy-tests. Builder (sonnet) d74cfe6683 on lane/check-judged-by-main-copy: lane lint lays main's copy of changed lint and test files. Round-1 reviewer (sonnet, 20:56 CST) FAIL: (1) the laid copies leave the work tree dirty, so the stale-cites check reads main's copy and can FAIL a lane that adds a cited name; (2) a lane that changes code and re-points a test is judged by main's old test and fails; 53 of the last 150 main commits touch a judged file; (3) a mutant that drops restore_lane_copies survives; (4) rename plus weaken passes (low). Finding 2 is an owner choice: page item 952 (a keep, b main's copy for all, c lint check files only, recommended). Builder round 2 fixes findings 1 and 3 whichever is picked. No pull request yet.
ask:
Lane brief: a guard or check file that a PR changes is judged by main's copy, not the PR's.
Governing: decision guard-guards-mistakes-only (harm bound). Harm: a lane that edits a guard or lint file could pass its own lane lint with the weaker copy. Not measured yet.
0. Explore (read-only, first line `Audit:`): does merge --lane-lint, or the reviewer brief, read the PR's copy of a changed check? Report yes or no with file and line.
1. If yes: test-author writes a red case where a PR weakens a check and still passes. If no: close the step with the read as proof.
2. builder fixes; reviewer (guard or check: yes).
Proof command: the red case green through `~/.claude/bin/verdict`. Report cap: 25 lines.
